```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("instacart")
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Number of Items per Order by Day of Week

```{r order-boxplot, echo=FALSE}
order_summary = instacart |>
  group_by(order_id, order_dow) |>
  summarize(
    item_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

box_plot = order_summary |>
  mutate(order_dow = factor(order_dow, levels = 0:6)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = order_dow, y = item_count)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Day of Week",
    y = "Number of Items per Order"
  )

ggplotly(box_plot)
```

### Top 10 Product Departments

```{r top-departments, echo=FALSE}
top_departments = instacart |>
  count(department, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

plot_ly(
  top_departments,
  x = ~reorder(department, n),
  y = ~n,
  type = "bar"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Products Purchased"),
    margin = list(b = 110)
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Product Popularity vs. Reorder Rate

```{r product-reorders, echo=FALSE}
product_summary = instacart |>
  group_by(product_name) |>
  summarize(
    purchases = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(purchases, n = 100)

plot_ly(
  product_summary,
  x = ~purchases,
  y = ~reorder_rate,
  text = ~product_name,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Purchases"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Reorder Rate", tickformat = ".0%")
  )
```
